activate_pose_tensor: activate encoded pose parameters with configurable activation functions for translation, quaternion, and focal length components
apply_base_pose_activation: apply a basic activation function like linear, inv_log, exp, or relu to pose encoding tensors
activate_head_3d_points: process network output tensors to extract 3D points and confidence values with configurable activation types
apply_inverse_log_transform: apply the inverse log transform formula sign(y) times exp(|y|) minus 1 to a PyTorch tensor
review_head_act_module: review the head_act module functions for pose activation and 3D point extraction in VGGT model heads
